findings.label: Admin secret exposed in browser bundle
findings.description: NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_SECRET is baked into the JS bundle at build time and is readable by anyone who loads the admin page. The API route's isAuthorized check accepts it as a valid credential. Rename to ADMIN_SECRET and remove the NEXT_PUBLIC_ variant from both isAuthorized and the dashboard component; pass the secret via a server-set cookie or proxy calls through a server action.

findings.label: Admin page publicly accessible — no auth guard
findings.description: /admin/qr is reachable by anyone; only a TODO comment acknowledges the gap. Add Next.js middleware that checks a session cookie and redirects unauthenticated requests before the page renders.

findings.label: .env.local.example missing from disk
findings.description: The verification report lists it as created, but the file does not exist in the repository. Without it, developers have no reference for the four required env vars and the project will throw at createClient() on first run. Recreate and commit the file.

findings.label: Text-column FK has no slug-immutability guard
findings.description: qr_scans(slug) references qr_links(slug) as plain text. Any future code path that updates a slug would break existing scan rows with no DB-level error. Add a BEFORE UPDATE trigger on qr_links rejecting slug changes, or migrate the FK to reference qr_links.id.
